name: MedlinePlus
description: US National Library of Medicine consumer health encyclopaedia, with women's health topics, drug information and lab-test explainers; also in Spanish.

name: Office on Women's Health (HHS)
description: US federal portal covering the life course: periods, pregnancy, menopause, mental health, violence and screening.

name: NHS Health A-Z
description: UK National Health Service condition pages with symptoms, treatment and when to seek care.

name: ACOG Patient Education
description: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists FAQs and patient guides, written by clinicians.

name: Cochrane Library
description: Systematic reviews of interventions. Abstracts and plain-language summaries are free; includes a large pregnancy and childbirth collection.

name: NICE Guidance
description: UK evidence-based guidelines, including menopause, endometriosis, fertility, antenatal and postnatal care.

name: WHO Reproductive Health Library
description: WHO-supported evidence summaries and practical guidance on sexual and reproductive health.

name: Family Planning: A Global Handbook for Providers
description: WHO / Johns Hopkins CCP handbook on contraceptive methods, eligibility and counselling.

name: CDC Contraception
description: CDC contraception pages, including the US Medical Eligibility Criteria and Selected Practice Recommendations.

name: ESHRE Guidelines
description: European Society of Human Reproduction and Embryology guidelines on infertility, endometriosis, recurrent pregnancy loss and more.

name: Human Fertility Database
description: Harmonised fertility statistics by country (Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research and Vienna Institute of Demography). Free registration.

name: MotherToBaby
description: Nonprofit fact sheets on medication, vaccine and exposure safety in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

name: LactMed
description: NLM database of drugs and their levels in breast milk and effects on nursing infants; peer-reviewed and referenced.

name: WHO Maternal Health
description: WHO guidance on antenatal, intrapartum and postnatal care and maternal mortality.

name: Postpartum Support International
description: Nonprofit providing information and peer support for perinatal mood and anxiety disorders.

name: Open Systems Pharmacology: Pregnancy Models
description: Physiologically based pharmacokinetic models for pregnant women, for modelling drug exposure in pregnancy.

name: AllofUs_Pregnancy_Episodes
description: Scripts for identifying pregnancy episodes in the All of Us Research Program data (MIT licence).

name: PCOS International Guideline
description: Evidence-based international guideline for the assessment and management of polycystic ovary syndrome, with translations and clinician and patient summaries.

name: Endometriosis UK
description: Charity with patient information on endometriosis and adenomyosis.

name: Endometriosis-Adenomyosis-Resources
description: Community-curated CC0 list of endometriosis and adenomyosis resources. Check the primary sources it points to.

name: AtlasEndometriosis
description: Code for a single-cell transcriptomic analysis of endometriosis, endometriomas and eutopic endometrium (no licence file).

name: The Menopause Society
description: Professional society with patient-facing information on menopause and its management.

name: British Menopause Society
description: UK clinical society with patient fact sheets and evidence-based consensus statements.

name: SWAN: Study of Women's Health Across the Nation
description: Longitudinal US cohort of the menopausal transition; public-use data are distributed through ICPSR.

name: FRAX
description: WHO-linked fracture risk calculator developed at the University of Sheffield.

name: Bone Health and Osteoporosis Foundation
description: US nonprofit offering osteoporosis prevention and treatment information.

name: National Cancer Institute
description: Evidence-reviewed PDQ summaries on breast, cervical, ovarian and endometrial cancer, plus screening information.

name: Genomic Data Commons
description: TCGA and related cohorts including breast, ovarian, cervical and uterine cancers. Open-access tier plus controlled data.

name: cBioPortal
description: Interactive exploration of cancer genomics; has an R client (cBioPortalData) and API.

name: BRCA Exchange
description: Global Alliance for Genomics and Health aggregation of BRCA1 and BRCA2 variant interpretations.

name: The Cancer Imaging Archive
description: Public medical imaging collections, including mammography datasets.

name: Mirai
description: Python code for a mammography-based breast cancer risk model (MIT licence). Research code, not a clinical tool.

name: consensusOV
description: R/Bioconductor package implementing four subtype classifiers for high-grade serous ovarian cancer.

name: Go Red for Women
description: American Heart Association resources on women-specific cardiovascular risk and symptoms.

name: Biology of Sex Differences
description: Open-access journal on sex differences in physiology and disease.

name: SAGER Guidelines
description: European Association of Science Editors guidelines for reporting sex and gender in study design, analysis and publication.

name: NIH Office of Research on Women's Health
description: NIH office guiding research on women's health and the inclusion of women and sex as a biological variable.

name: GTEx Portal
description: Tissue gene expression across donors, including sex-biased expression and female reproductive tissues.

name: Human Protein Atlas
description: Protein and RNA expression across human tissues, including ovary, endometrium, breast and placenta.

name: DHS Program
description: Nationally representative household surveys in 90+ countries on fertility, family planning, maternal and child health. Free registration.

name: IPUMS DHS
description: Harmonised DHS microdata across countries and survey waves. Free registration.

name: PMA Data
description: Performance Monitoring for Action: open survey data on family planning, maternal health and reproductive health in several countries.

name: UNICEF MICS
description: Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys with women's health, fertility and maternal indicators.

name: WHO Global Health Observatory
description: WHO indicator data with API and bulk downloads, including maternal and reproductive health.

name: World Bank Gender Data Portal
description: Sex-disaggregated indicators on health, education and economic participation.

name: Global Burden of Disease Results
description: IHME estimates of disease burden by sex, age and location. Free for non-commercial use with registration.

name: CDC National Survey of Family Growth
description: US survey of pregnancy, contraception, infertility and sexual health, with public-use files.

name: NHANES
description: US nutrition and health examination survey; analysable by sex and reproductive status.

name: All of Us Research Program
description: Large US cohort with EHR, survey and genomic data. Free registered-access tier for approved researchers.

name: Women's Health Initiative (BioLINCC)
description: WHI trial and observational data on postmenopausal women, available on request through NHLBI BioLINCC.

name: menstrualcycleR
description: R package for preparing longitudinal menstrual cycle data for analysis (GPL-3.0).

name: rdhs
description: rOpenSci R client for the DHS API and data munging.

name: drip.
description: Offline, non-commercial cycle and fertility tracker by the Bloody Health collective (GPL-3.0). On F-Droid and GitHub (bloodyhealth/drip). Check release activity before relying on it.

name: Mensinator
description: Privacy-focused Android period tracker (MIT); listed on F-Droid.

name: Menstrudel
description: Free, offline, open-source period tracker (GPL-3.0).

name: Ovumcy
description: Self-hosted, privacy-first menstrual cycle tracker, Docker-ready (AGPL-3.0).

name: peri
description: Open-source period tracker app (MIT).

name: Bluemoon
description: Privacy-friendly menstruation tracker on F-Droid (GPL-3.0-or-later). Search link used; confirm the package page.

name: Periodical
description: Menstrual calendar with fertile-day estimates by the Knaus-Ogino calendar method, on F-Droid (GPL-3.0-or-later). The method is less reliable than modern fertility-awareness methods; treat as a calendar, not contraception.

name: log28
description: No-frills period tracker on F-Droid (LGPL-3.0). Latest F-Droid release is from 2020; check maintenance first.

name: fertility-test-analyzer
description: Android app for quantifying ovulation and pregnancy test strips (Apache-2.0).

name: BMC Women's Health
description: Open-access, peer-reviewed research across women's health.

name: Reproductive Health
description: Open-access journal on reproductive and sexual health, with a global health focus.

name: Frontiers in Reproductive Health
description: Open-access journal covering reproductive health and care.

name: Europe PMC
description: Free full-text biomedical literature search; filter for open access and preprints.
